question: Should OpenClaw sponsor WhatsApp-specific per-direct and per-group debounce overrides as a permanent public configuration contract?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces and the discussion contains no maintainer confirmation of the intended scope or permanence.

options.title: Keep the decision in the canonical issue
options.body: Close this unsponsored PR now and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54565 to choose the permanent product contract before reopening or resubmitting implementation.

options.title: Sponsor this exact contract
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve both direct and group overrides with the documented specific, wildcard, account-map replacement, and channel fallback semantics.

options.title: Sponsor a narrower contract
options.body: A maintainer can request a group-only or generic cross-channel design and invite a correspondingly narrowed replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Keep the decision in the canonical issue
recommendation.body: Close this unsponsored PR now and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54565 to choose the permanent product contract before reopening or resubmitting implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent authorship and merger history on the shared debounce contract makes this the strongest available routing signal for the product-level decision.
